title: Meal-kit and grocery tools to explore
intro: Soft CTAs for established meal-kit and grocery patterns when you are modelling subscription boxes against supermarket cooking and grocery delivery. Confirm coverage, box prices and pause rules on each site — this block is not a ranking of meal-kit apps.

items.reason: Central meal-kit modelling option — useful when comparing predictable dinner costs, portioned ingredients and pause/skip habits with supermarket cooking.
App-based grocery delivery alternative when you are weighing meal kits against shopping your own ingredients with delivery convenience.
Full-service supermarket baseline and AH Bezorgen — useful when modelling kit per-serving cost against store-brand cooking and weekly shop habits.
